sanskrit_verse: दीयमानं न गृह्णाति प्रयुक्तं यः स्वकं धनम् । मध्यस्थस्थापितं चेत् स्याद् वर्धते न ततः परम् ॥
transliteration: dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇāti prayuktaṃ yaḥ svakaṃ dhanam | madhyasthasthāpitaṃ cet syād vardhate na tataḥ param ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who does not accept what is rightfully offered or bestowed, though entitled thereto, and further causes a neutral arbiter to intervene in the disposition of personal wealth, shall find no increase beyond that which has already been established.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides inherently in the rightful owner until consciously transferred
Causation is attributed to refusal of lawful entitlement followed by external arbitration
Capacity-based responsibility includes both acceptance and proper stewardship of one's own resources
Restoration logic requires realignment with natural flow of ownership and energetic abundance
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of self-worth and rightful possession without abdication
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, where an individual declines their rightful share yet invokes judicial mediation thereafter, such conduct indicates a disconnection from dharmic proprietorship. The court must recognize this as a forfeiture of future accrual tied to that asset, based on the principle of conscious refusal disrupting karmic-economic flow.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes clear causal sequence: first, rejection of lawful gain; second, invocation of third-party settlement; third, stagnation of value. This sequence reflects anupūrvaśaḥ—ordered unfolding due to misaligned consciousness. Responsibility lies in restoring integrity to ownership perception rather than imposing punitive measures.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-establish connection between individual and inherent right to accept lawful gains
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Guide agent through conscious reaffirmation of self-value and entitlement
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Facilitate energetic clearing around financial worthiness and abundance reception
Integrity Reintegration Practice: Align internal consciousness with dharmic function of receiving and managing personal property
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is hereby restored. Wealth flows according to conscious alignment. There is no punishment, only consequence. Reality responds to consciousness. The Supreme Adjudicator is Awareness itself.
